title: Header
tagline: Social Network app for content creators that decides the price of the art in the DAO way
description: Header ( our project :) ) is an app that lets content creators to post their work and to share their work. The app lets the other individuals to decide either the post is relevant or not. The other persons can do that by giving a nod or a shake to the post. Giving nod to a post means that you like that post if you do not like the post you can give shake. The price of the art that the cont creator posted on header will be decided in an exponential. Also the posts will have a section where artists can introduce their hashtags. By doing this we made something with the help of the Zora API and polygon data to categorise the hashtags by popularity . For example if there are 100 post with the hashtag: "#life" but the number of appreciations is low. This will not influence a lot, but if there are 10 post with a lot of likes this will predict the fact that this hashtag can be in trending. Also you users can search their favorite artist in search bar.
how_its_made: This project is made with NodeJS, Javascript and React as programming languages. We've made an external API with NodeJS so that we can fetch data in the smart contract as we want, also the smart contract due to the API makes the NF in real time. After that the website app is made with NodeJs in the backend and ReactJS in frontend. We've use Moralis to login with metamsk and Zora API to fetch the NFTs from the contract.
